scope: Static independent read-only code review and inspection of existing generated screenshots/metrics. No runtime tests or browser interactions were performed by this reviewer.

observations: Named groups and the separate reset boundary are visible at all six layouts, with no visible text clipping or unreadable labels.
All six metrics show panel scroll width equal to client width and zero clipped text/control entries.
Controls are at least 48 pixels high in ordinary layouts and at least 49.78 pixels high with large text; maximum height is 80.56 pixels.
Control font size is at least 16 pixels in ordinary layouts and 18 pixels with large text; descriptive text is at least 14 and 16 pixels respectively.
Grouped pressed and disabled states remain visible in high contrast and forced colors.
Desktop and tablet controls no longer stretch to the frame-options height. The large-text Annotate button wraps onto two readable lines.
Native PNG artifacts visibly contain the current canvas anatomy, guides, and configured lens overlays; the offscreen export visibly uses the lateral view.

unitGuardRevision: Reviewed the repository unit tests after the root replaced inherited source-instance spies with independent own vi.fn guards and deleted those own properties during cleanup. Assertions remain strict.
